# Loss or divergence of external side-effects (wiki/embeddings/publish)

Wiki emission, embedding generation, and wiki publishing are performed after the persistent compile commit and are allowed to fail without rolling back. Failures are recorded only as warnings, which risks external state (wiki, embeddings, published branch) becoming inconsistent with the persisted compile without strong notice.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._emit_wiki`

- [knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter](../component/knowledge-compiler-wiki-emitter.md)
